answer: select count(distinct l.c0039) from t0002 l join t0000 p on p.c0006=l.c0039 where l.c0043 like '%+%' and p.c0003 is null
note: positive CRP taken as a '+' style result

answer: select count(*) from t0000 p where p.c0002='-' and exists(select 1 from t0002 l where l.c0039=p.c0006 and l.c0033 not between 29 and 52) and exists(select 1 from t0002 l where l.c0039=p.c0006 and l.c0002 is not null and cast(l.c0002 as real)>16)

select round(avg(l.c0041-8.5),3) from t0002 l where l.c0041>8.5 and l.c0039 in (select p.c0006 from t0000 p where p.c0000='F' and p.c0006 in (select c0006 from t0001 where c0008 like '%SLE%' and c0008 not like '%SLE susp%'))
select sum(c0000='F') as women, sum(c0000='M') as men from t0000 p where p.c0006 in (select c0039 from t0002 where c0002 is not null and cast(c0002 as real)>32)
select count(distinct c0006) from t0001 where c0003>0 and c0005 between '1997-01-01' and '1997-12-31'
select count(*) from t0000 p where c0000='F' and exists(select 1 from t0002 l where l.c0039=p.c0006 and l.c0029 is not null and cast(l.c0029 as real)<8)

select p.c0006,p.c0000,l.c0031,l.c0022 from t0000 p join t0002 l on l.c0039=p.c0006 where l.c0022 is not null and l.c0031=(select max(c0031) from t0002 x where x.c0039=p.c0006 and x.c0022 is not null)

select p.c0001 from t0000 p join t0002 l on l.c0039=p.c0006 where l.c0003<60 and p.c0006 in (select c0039 from t0002 where c0002 is not null and cast(c0002 as real)>=16) group by p.c0006 order by max(l.c0003) desc, p.c0006 asc limit 3

select cast(strftime('%Y',l.c0031)-strftime('%Y',p.c0001) - (strftime('%m-%d',l.c0031)<strftime('%m-%d',p.c0001)) as int) as age, p.c0004 from t0002 l join t0000 p on p.c0006=l.c0039 where p.c0002='+' and l.c0029 is not null order by cast(l.c0029 as real) desc, l.c0031 asc limit 1

select (select count(*) from t0000 p join t0002 l on l.c0039=p.c0006 where p.c0000='F' and l.c0031=(select max(c0031) from t0002 x where x.c0039=p.c0006) and l.c0002 is not null and cast(l.c0002 as real)>=32) - (select count(*) from t0000 p join t0002 l on l.c0039=p.c0006 where p.c0000='M' and l.c0031=(select max(c0031) from t0002 x where x.c0039=p.c0006) and l.c0002 is not null and cast(l.c0002 as real)>=32)
select count(*) from t0000 where c0000='F' and c0002='+' and c0005 between '1998-01-01' and '1998-12-31'
select c0004 from t0000 where c0002='+' and c0005 between '1998-02-15' and '1998-02-28' order by c0001 asc, c0006 asc limit 1

select c0000 as sex, count(*) from t0000 p where c0000 in ('M','F') and not exists(select 1 from t0002 l where l.c0039=p.c0006 and l.c0003>=60) group by c0000
